title: Fusion Cells
summary: Heavy power day and night, burning exotic isotopes. With none left it goes dark.
text:
The research **Isotope Cells** unlocks the **Fusion Cell**: by far the most power of any building, day and night, wherever you like.

The catch is fuel. A Fusion Cell burns exotic isotopes (◇) all the time it runs. With none in store it goes dark, and so does everything leaning on it. Keep a Deep-Core Mine working, and an eye on the ◇ count.

The same research unlocks the **Matter Printer**, which turns spare power into alloys: fusion is the usual way to feed one.
